reported consolidated net sales of $430m for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, unchanged from the prior-year quarter, and year-to-date net sales of $1,115 million, up 1% versus the first nine months of 2025.

European based operations generated $306 million in third-quarter sales, a 4% increase versus the 2025 third quarter, reflecting 3% organic growth and a 1% contribution from new brands, partially offset by a 1% foreign exchange headwind. United States based operations produced $127 million in third-quarter sales, a 7% decline compared with the year-ago quarter.
Intercompany eliminations totaled ($4) million for the quarter.

title: Interparfums reports flat third-quarter sales at $430M; European operations rise while U.S. shipments delayed
